# text/template calls a method with no arguments when it is not the last name
# of a chain, so .Route.GetUser.Method fails at render; muxt check reports it.
# Call the method in parentheses with its arguments instead:
# {{(.Route.GetUser 1).Method}}.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
! muxt check
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- t.gohtml --
{{define "GET /user/{id} GetUser(id)"}}{{.Route.GetUser.Method}}{{end}}
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var fs embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(fs, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) GetUser(id int) int { return id }
